CustomField.description: The Actionable Date is going to be used by the support admin team to note when a case needs to be picked up. They'll frequently get cases - like termination and new client creation cases - well before the actions actually need to be taken. They're going to use the actionable field to tag the case with the date it needs to be actioned and then update their queue so that is visible.
CustomField.label: Actionable Date
